account:
Today has mostly looked like ordinary town business. The secretary reported no receipts or expenses. The innkeeper reported no concerns, eight fresh loaves, and no lodging requests. Freight said the warehouse was empty this morning and reported no unusual shipments or quay concerns; later I heard freight advertising ferry crossings, deliveries, and storage. The builder reported the bridge, bakery approach, landing approach, and quay road passable, without verified damage. I approved a two-emerald closer visual bridge inspection with a report due tomorrow noon, though there was earlier confusion about that authorization.

The only new, potentially unusual detail is the neighbour's remark at tea that the baker says 'the lanterns are simply a welcoming light.' I have not personally seen these lanterns or learned where they are, when they appeared, or whom they welcome. The wording makes me curious about a gathering or some other activity I have not heard about, but that is only a possibility, not evidence of anything secret. The baker may know their purpose, and the neighbour has heard something about them. My question about their location and purpose went unheard; I have now returned within two blocks of the neighbour to ask again. I should still keep my 16:30 office appointment.
